scope: Index catalog, sensor band mappings, and threshold resources

criteria.statement: Resources distinguish mathematical range, observed range, encoded storage, physical units and classification thresholds; formula constants and sensor applicability cite original/official sources.

evidence.observed: Read back 19 indices: mathematical ranges, typical observed field ranges, dimensionless units, and primary citations (Rouse 1974, Huete 2002, McFeeters 1996, Gao 1996, Hall 1995, etc.) verified.
Read back sensor mappings: Landsat TM/ETM+/OLI, Sentinel-2 MSI, MODIS, HLS, Level-2 scaling (DN*0.0000275 - 0.2), and S2 L2A offsets documented.

criteria.statement: NDWI, NDSI and RVI ambiguity and Gao wavelength versus NDMI approximations are explicit; unknown thresholds remain unavailable for automatic classification.

evidence.observed: Read back alias collision table and threshold rules: NDWI McFeeters vs Gao, NDSI snow vs salinity, and RVI SAR vs optical Jordan simple ratio explicitly separated.
Read back threshold profiles: all profiles marked approved_for_automatic_classification=false with mandatory caveats against universal use.

criteria.statement: Structured resources validate unique IDs, references, source/runtime verification and license/version metadata without duplicating existing catalogs.

evidence.observed: test_indices_catalog_schema, test_source_registry_schema, and test_threshold_profiles_safety_guard passed with unique IDs and MIT license.
